Input Props to pass to the selected composition of your video. Must be a serialized JSON string (`--props='{"hello": "world"}'`) or a path to a JSON file (`./path/to/props.json`).

## CLI flag

Use `--props` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                         | Flag              |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                           | `--props <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                           | `--props <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                             | `--props <value>` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)               | `--props <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)                     | `--props <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)             | `--props <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)               | `--props <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions) | `--props <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)         | `--props <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)           | `--props <value>` |
